name: godot_animation_edit
description: Create and modify animations on an AnimationPlayer and preview them in the editor: create, delete, or update animations, add and remove tracks and keyframes, backfill RESET keys for existing tracks (create_reset_keys), and play, stop, or seek the editor's preview (playback controls the editor, not the running game). Pair each change with an immediate play or seek to check the result; this is the only way to verify animation feel without running the whole game. To inspect animation data without changing it, use godot_animation_read.

action.description:
play: Play an animation
stop: Stop playback. Godot leaves the first keyframe values on the nodes unless the player has a RESET animation; the reply warns when it does not.
seek: Seek to a position in the current animation
create: Create an animation
delete: Delete an animation
update_props: Update animation properties
add_track: Add a track to an animation
create_reset_keys: Backfill RESET keys for existing tracks: every track on one animation (or all of the player's animations) gets a RESET key holding the property's current value where RESET lacks one. Use it on tracks authored by hand or before add_track keyed RESET automatically, and call it BEFORE previewing, while the nodes still hold their rest pose.
remove_track: Remove a track
add_keyframe: Add a keyframe to a track
remove_keyframe: Remove a keyframe
update_keyframe: Update a keyframe

animation_name.description: for play: Animation name; for create: Animation name; for delete: Animation name; for update_props: Animation name; for add_track: Animation name; for create_reset_keys: Animation to cover (default: all animations on the player except RESET); for remove_track: Animation name; for add_keyframe: Animation name; for remove_keyframe: Animation name; for update_keyframe: Animation name (required for: play, create, delete, update_props, add_track, remove_track, add_keyframe, remove_keyframe, update_keyframe; optional for: create_reset_keys)

custom_blend.description: Custom blend time, -1 for default (for: play)

from_end.description: Play from end for reverse (for: play)

keep_state.description: Keep the current pose instead of seeking to the first keyframe (default false) (for: stop)

seconds.description: Position to seek to (required for: seek)

update.description: Update node immediately, default true (for: seek)

length.description: Animation length in seconds (for: create, update_props)

loop_mode.description: Loop mode: none, linear, pingpong (for: create, update_props)

step.description: Step value for keyframe snapping (for: create, update_props)

track_path.description: Node path and property, e.g. "Sprite2D:frame" (required for: add_track)

insert_at.description: Track index to insert at, -1 for end (for: add_track)

create_reset.description: Also key the property's current value into the player's RESET animation (created if missing), as the editor's track panel does, so previews are undone by RESET and save writes the rest pose. Default true. (for: add_track)

track_index.description: Track index (required for: remove_track, add_keyframe, remove_keyframe, update_keyframe)

time.description: Keyframe time in seconds (required for: add_keyframe; optional for: update_keyframe)

value.description: Keyframe value, typed to match the track's target property: numbers and strings as-is; Color as {r, g, b, a}; Vector2 as {x, y}; Vector3 as {x, y, z}; Quaternion/Vector4 as {x, y, z, w} (the same shape get_keyframes and get_properties emit). A bare numeric array of the right length is accepted for those types; any other mismatch is rejected with TYPE_MISMATCH rather than stored and coerced to black/zero at play time. (for: add_keyframe, update_keyframe)

method_name.description: Method name for method tracks (for: add_keyframe)
